connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -9.69, length 3.31 mm) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm, y -9.69 -> -3.09) touching the radiating edge y=-3.09 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

parasitic_params.note: Floating sheet (no via, no probe), same metal as the patch. Lp 7.46 -> 7.05 mm (y -2.91...4.14, centre 0.615 mm). The sheet stays inside y >= -2.91, so it does not lie over the 0.8 mm transformer / 50 ohm line: the patch edge is y = -3.09 (patch_L/2), the transformer ends there on z = h and the sheet (z = 1.035) starts 0.18 mm above it in y. The edge -2.91 must not be moved (prepare grading check).

rationale: Round 037 (design-reviewer Fable proposal, approved by owner), reference US3_PS4 (run 036: worst S11 -10.66 dB, eta 0.677...0.244, gain 4.3...-0.48 dBi). Diagnosis (GUIDE_MODEL, Fable two-coupled-resonator model; NOT EM): the upper mode of PS1/PS4 is weakly radiating and dissipates in the FR4, which causes the eta valley and the gain drop in the channel. PS5 moves that mode out of the channel (~ +410 MHz) and centres the bright mode (~ +85 MHz). The double resonance inside the channel is given up in exchange for eta. Changes: patch_L 6.302 -> 6.18 mm, Lp 7.46 -> 7.05 mm (y -2.91...4.14); U-slot in absolute coordinates, transformer, line, z_par, Wp, material and port unchanged. The mode shifts are model estimates, not simulation results. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11, gain, efficiency or bandwidth is claimed.
purpose: Test, in openEMS, whether pushing the weakly radiating upper mode out of the channel (>= 8.45 GHz) and centring the bright mode (~ 7.93-8.01 GHz) keeps worst-in-channel S11 <= -8 dB while eta and realized gain stay high at all 11 channel points (no valley), versus US3_PS4 (036).

US3_PS4.note: Documented exception to one-change-per-round: two very unequal changes (patch_L -0.122 mm, Lp -0.41 mm) to discriminate the mode assignment. Transformer 0.80 x 6.60 mm, U-slot (absolute coordinates), z_par 1.035 mm, Wp 11.0 mm, material, board and port unchanged.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H0: Lower S11 minimum at 7.93-8.01 GHz and upper feature (minimum or loop) at 8.45-8.60 GHz. If the upper feature falls below 8.30 GHz and the lower minimum rises by more than 200 MHz, the mode assignment is inverted -> stop.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Worst S11 in the channel <= -8.0 dB (Fable guide: ~ -9.4 dB, range -8.2...-9.7; -10 dB not expected).
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: eta >= 0.55 and realized broadside gain >= 2 dBi at all 11 points (expected >= 3.3 dBi), Dmax within 20 deg of broadside.
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: H1 and H2 true -> next round: only transformer 6.6 -> 7.1 mm (US3_PS6) if worst S11 is between -8 and -10 dB, or fine mesh if already <= -10 dB. H2 false (valley in the channel) -> close the buried-parasitic-in-FR4 route.

manufacturability.layers: 3 copper layers (L1 patch + feed + U-slot at z=h, L2 floating parasitic at z=1.035 mm, L3 ground at z=0) and 2 dielectric layers of ~1.035 mm each: a standard 3-copper-layer FR4 multilayer (core + prepreg/core).
manufacturability.vias: none: the parasitic is floating (no probe, no plated through hole in the antenna region); the feed is a planar microstrip.
manufacturability.min_feature_mm: U-slot arms 0.8 mm and gaps as in US3_MS3 (unchanged); parasitic is a solid rectangle 11.0 x 7.05 mm; smallest planar gap: 0.18 mm in y between the transformer end and the sheet edge (different layers, z offset 1.035 mm); no copper feature < 0.8 mm.
manufacturability.stackup_note: Dielectric thickness and the exact z of the buried copper depend on the fabricator's core/prepreg library; typical core thicknesses of ~1.0-1.2 mm and prepreg of 0.1-0.2 mm are only an orientation (NOT verified against a datasheet). The model assumes ONE homogeneous eps_r=4.4 over 2.07 mm, so the fabricator must give the real stackup (the prepreg/core eps_r can differ from the core and sets z_par and k).
manufacturability.tolerances_to_specify: layer-to-layer registration and dielectric thickness ( +-z_par moves k and f2 ); etching of Lp (guide: ~10 MHz per 0.01 mm). Same rough FR4 + copper-roughness caveat as the rest of the campaign.
manufacturability.risks: z_par and registration are not controlled by the TFG; homogeneous provisional FR4 model; a floating inner sheet cannot be inspected or tuned after lamination. PS5 shifts are large (patch_L -0.122 mm, Lp -0.41 mm) versus etching tolerance (guide ~7-10 MHz per 0.01 mm), so tolerance is less critical than for PS4, but the 0.18 mm y offset of the sheet edge from the patch edge is of the order of the layer registration tolerance.
